newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound overnight rates narrow.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound overnight rates narrow.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound narrowed on Tuesday to between 10-1/8 and 10-1/4 percent from Monday's 10 and 10-7/16 percent in a liquid market that started short, bankers said.
Many bankers said they had no one-week deals before Christmas and New Year holidays but one banker said he made a deal at 10-1/4 compared to 10-3/8 and 10-7/16 on Monday.
State-owned banks maintained their minimum overnight lending rate at 10-1/2 percent, bankers said.
